weight_normalization_note: quality_weighted_bce uses sum(w*bce)/sum(w); no second renormalization

lambda_selection.rule: Choose lambda separately for A4 and A5 by mean validation AUC over seeds 42/123/456. Ties: prefer smaller lambda. Freeze chosen lambdas in matrix.json before any internal_test read.
lambda_selection.budget: For each of A4/A5 and each candidate lambda, run the same max_epochs/early-stopping protocol on all three train seeds. No extra epochs beyond the shared matrix budget.
lambda_selection.when_internal_test_allowed: Only after A0-A5 and S1/S2 are frozen (including chosen lambdas) and written to results/phase1/frozen_config.json

A4.name: uniform_bce_contrastive
A4.lambda_selection: must be chosen on validation AUC only; 0.05 is a provisional default, not test-tuned

A5.name: reverse_quality_contrastive
A5.lambda_selection: must be chosen on validation AUC only; 0.05 is a provisional default, not test-tuned

S1.name: minilm_cosine
S1.equivalence: identical to S2 under L2-normalized caches

S2.name: minilm_dot
S2.equivalence: identical to S1 under L2-normalized caches
